rule: A chain is listed only where a current, dated source shows a public screening from a film print (35mm or 70mm) at one of its venues in 2026. Projectors kept in a booth do not count. Digital-only chains are not listed.

not_listed: Event Cinemas, HOYTS, Village, Reading, Wallis, United, Majestic and other circuits: no 2026 film-print screening found; their IMAX and premium screens are digital.
Five Star New Farm: a screen is reported as equipped for 35mm, but no dated 2026 film screening was found, so it is not listed.
Independent single venues that run film (Ritz Randwick, Hayden Orpheum, IMAX Melbourne, Sun Yarraville, Mercury Adelaide, GOMA Cinémathèque and others) are not chains and are not on this list.
